game.title: Dead Space 3
game.blurb: Third-person survival horror shooter from Visceral Games, published by Electronic Arts, released 2013-02-05. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 4154); RAWG keeps "Dead Space 3: Awakened" as a separate entry. Steam app 1238060 ("Dead Space™ 3", also RAWG's Steam store link) is used. 16 of 58 Steam achievements are hidden. GOSCC_1 to GOSCC_14 come first in the schema with mostly falling unlock rates, so they look like story progress; the first five were placed in the early story chapter and the rest, with the hidden GOSCC_21 and GOSCC_41, in the later one, a reasoned guess from API order and percentages. "Heretic", "True Believer" and "Get to the Chopper!" sit next to the two Awakened achievements (GOSCC_51 to 55) with similar rates, so they were put in the Awakened chapter, also a guess. StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 0: only a short Table of Contents subpage (about 250 characters) exists; Controls, Gameplay and Walkthrough are linked but not written. deadspace.fandom.com answers the API under "Dead Space 3", with about 189 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
